name: Role takeover chain with the assume leg fully Denied (deny suppresses the chain)
note: IAM-902 deny interaction: the grant + trust-modify + assume grants are all present on the same role, but a same-policy explicit Deny removes sts:AssumeRole on that exact role. Explicit-Deny precedence blocks the assume leg, so the compound ROLE-TAKEOVER must NOT fire (only 2 of the 3 legs survive). The surviving modify primitives still surface.
